spread.verdict: NO PICK: no model passes both validation criteria; locked holdout and live check not scored

total.verdict: NO PICK: no model passes both validation criteria; locked holdout and live check not scored

accept_if_all_on_VALIDATION_window: (a) K-adjusted bootstrap lower bound of the validation-window OLS slope of (actual - line) on the model's shrunk prediction is above zero
(b) K-adjusted bootstrap lower bound of the out-of-sample MSE delta (baseline MSE - model MSE, fit-window coefficients applied to validation games) is above zero
(c) the model uses no movement feature (a closing-based feature cannot serve a decision)

bootstrap.interval: percentile; a model's lower bounds use alpha = 0.025 / K, K = models in the market's family (Bonferroni across the family); the unadjusted 95% bound is reported alongside

rule.cohort: completed lined events with a rebuilt PIT v6 projection and all of the model's features

feature_groups.movement: closing minus opening line (spread: implied home margin; total: total points). CLOSING-BASED: not usable at decision time, diagnostic only
feature_groups.nond1: either side lacks an ESPN conference id (non-Division-I opponent), and x * flag
feature_groups.rest: min(rest days home, 7) - min(rest days away, 7); no prior game = 7
feature_groups.sample: min(prior current-season games of the two teams, 15) and x * 1[that < 8]
feature_groups.tempo: mean of the two teams' last-10-game shot attempts (FGA + 0.44 FTA, game average) minus the running league mean of all prior games, PIT

rule.if_accepted: the accepted model with the largest validation MSE delta is scored once on 2025-26; only if it also passes (a) and (b) there with the plain 95% bounds is 2026-27 scored, once; side record follows the sign of the shrunk prediction when |prediction| >= 1 point, pushes excluded. A model whose v6 coefficient is negative is labelled fade-v6, not v6 skill
rule.if_not_accepted: NO PICK; the locked holdout and the live check are NOT scored for that market
rule.line: ESPN pinned median of non-live providers (rule ncaab-espn-lines-rule-1), CLOSING benchmark
rule.model: ridge on standardised features (alpha 1000 fixed, standardisation and coefficients from the FIT window only) predicting actual - line; the prediction used everywhere is 0.5 x the ridge prediction (shrinkage); baseline = line only = fit-window mean residual
rule.movement_models: m_move (v6+movement) and m_joint_move join the family only if rows with an opening line number at least 2000 in the fit window and at least 1000 in the validation window; otherwise movement is reported as a labelled exploratory diagnostic (a movement-only ridge on the rows carrying an opening line, chronological 60/20/20 by date, which spends part of the 2025-26 and 2026-27 windows for movement alone) that cannot affect acceptance. Either way a movement model is never an accepted pick model
rule.no_tuning: no grids, no per-bucket cuts, no other features; alpha, shrinkage, threshold fixed above

targets.spread: home margin minus implied home margin (implied = -home_spread_line)

rule.v6: ncaab_spread_v6_model()/ncaab_total_v6_model() served parameters, history strictly before the game's ET calendar day, current neutral-site flag from the scoreboard, scoreboard box stats and AP ranks for tempo/rank priors

windows_by_espn_season_year.note: season year 2023 = 2022-23; 2022 (2021-22) is rating-history burn-in only
